name: docs show / for / find / list with --json
description: show <feature>[/<entry>] (single entry to save context); for <path> returns repo rules + entries whose when matches, current-state kinds only, plans only when feature in-progress or --plans; find <query> ranks by summary/keywords/body; list features with status.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: When adding show/find, change the hint line in ClaudeMdBlock.FeatureIndex: it currently says each feature lives in .repo-docs/<id>.yaml. Point agents to 'docs show <id>' / 'docs find <query>' instead; the user wants agents never to read or edit the YAML directly.

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 710e505. show <addr> [--full] (records reads), for <path> [--plans] [--all-kinds] [--full], find <query> [-n], list [-s]. Matching lives in Features/Queries/PathMatch: case-insensitive per-segment prefix plus * ? ** globs, and anchors match by path equality. Current-state kinds exclude decision (add with --all-kinds) and plan (unless the feature is in-progress or --plans). find score: id/address 1000, summary 100/term, keyword 10, body 1. The CLAUDE.md index hint now points to docs show/find. After merging, the begin marker text says to use the docs CLI. For #34: for does not apply push policies or record reads; DocsFor.ShortBodyLength = 600. Known side effect: MarkRead goes through Save and backfills a missing created on every entry in the file.
